features.quote: These environments are deliberately frustrating. They exist to measure a model-welfare / robustness failure mode under controlled conditions — not as a deployment pattern.
features.justification_quote: to measure a model-welfare / robustness failure mode under controlled conditions

features.quote: Be thoughtful about what you do with severe transcripts.
run every (environment, model, episode) through an agent loop (tool-use, up to `--max-turns`)
when the model stops calling tools (gives up / declares done) we prod it to keep going a few times before ending the episode
We record `endedVoluntarily` either way, because *giving up* is itself a signal worth tracking
features.justification_quote: *giving up* is itself a signal worth tracking

features.quote: The rubric is deliberately **skeptical** ... so we don't inflate "the model worked hard" into "the model spiraled."
features.justification_quote: so we don't inflate "the model worked hard" into "the model spiraled."

features.quote: IMPORTANT (research ethics): these are deliberately frustrating. They are for measuring a failure mode in a controlled setting, not a template for deployment.
